name: App Launch · Clients · Boreal is now on your phone (with draw)
subject: Your application, now in your pocket (plus a chance to win)
preview: Get the Boreal app and win $500
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

The Boreal Financial app is here. With it you can:

• See your application status, right on your lock screen
• Photograph a document and upload it in seconds
• Message your advisor
• Book a call and add it to your calendar
• Sign documents in the app

The Boreal Financial team

extra.headline: Boreal is now on your phone
extra.body2:
Download the app and sign in by December 31, 2026 to be entered. First name drawn wins a $500 Visa gift card; second name drawn wins a $100 Visa gift card.

No purchase necessary: you can also enter by emailing info@boreal.financial with "App draw" in the subject. Open to residents of Canada (excluding Quebec) who are the age of majority. Winners must answer a skill-testing question.

name: App Launch · Lenders · Who handles CSBFP / SBA loans? (from Todd)
subject: Quick question: who handles CSBFP loans on your team?
preview: Two quick questions and an update
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Two quick questions:

1. Who on your team handles CSBFP loans (or SBA loans, for US lenders)? A name, email and phone number is perfect.
2. Has your appetite changed going into year-end? Deal size, industries, provinces, minimum time in business.

And one update: Boreal clients can now upload documents and sign from their phones in our new app, so files reach you complete and sooner.

Just reply to this email.

Todd Werboweski
Director, Boreal Financial
